title: Chapter I: the boss at a sliver of hit points, the first blow is its last (the factory's proof of setup + until)
note: Review round 2, R2-M3: the widened spec the first real run could not film. `hp` names the BOSS (the enemy with most hit points) at 1 hit point, `quiet` marks the chapter's own hp-below scripts as played (lowering a boss otherwise runs seymour-half at the next action), `until` waits for the PICTURE (the boss's life state going down: the log says KO in the instant of the key press), `holdMenuMs` leaves the first menu open 1.5 s. A card whose moment never happens exits 3 with FAILED.txt.
